title: Stripe API Key accidentally committed to public repo
description: While updating billing service webhooks, an active live Stripe secret key was committed to github.com/alexrivera/billing-helper.
immediateActions: Key revoked in Stripe console within 12 minutes. Repo removed.

title: Clicked FedEx delivery reschedule link & entered Okta password
description: Employee clicked a tracking link mimicking FedEx and submitted corporate SSO credentials before noticing abnormal domain (fedx-portal-tracking.info).
immediateActions: User disconnected laptop from Wi-Fi. SOC forced session termination and triggered password reset.

title: Corporate MacBook Pro left in rideshare vehicle in Chicago
description: MacBook Pro M3 asset #LT-4421 left in rideshare trunk. Driver hasn't replied to dispatch calls.
immediateActions: MDM remote lock dispatched. BitLocker encryption verified. Corporate token revocation executed.

title: Client summary report emailed to external vendor with wrong CC recipient
description: Support analytics report containing 45 client organization names sent with typo in recipient address (vendor@gmail.com instead of vendor@enterprise-partner.com).
immediateActions: Recall attempted; partner notified; message purges confirmed. No financial records were included.

title: MFA Fatigue bombardment (14 prompt notifications in 3 minutes)
description: Adversary attempted push notification flood targeting user's Duo Mobile authenticator from IP in Eastern Europe.
immediateActions: User denied all prompts. IP geoblocked at border firewall. Primary Active Directory password reset.

title: Candidate resume downloaded as macro-enabled .docm file
description: Resume attached to applicant portal triggered endpoint EDR alerts upon extraction for malicious obfuscated VBA macros.
immediateActions: EDR automatically quarantined file before execution. Applicant IP blacklisted.

title: Fake vendor invoice banking update request
description: Received email purportedly from key cloud supplier requesting bank account routing change to an offshore entity.
immediateActions: Finance team initiated verbal out-of-band verification via supplier CFO; scam neutralized before any funds transferred.

title: Adware browser extension detected on marketing contractor laptop
description: Contractor installed unapproved 'Video Downloader Plus' extension which injected unauthorized affiliate links.
immediateActions: Extension blocked via Chrome Enterprise Policy; contractor warned regarding Sec 5.4 compliance.

title: Unredacted contract template sent to external counsel without encryption
description: Standard boilerplate contract template emailed without TLS forced mode.
immediateActions: Message verified to contain zero confidential terms. Gateway rule adjusted to enforce strict TLS for all legal domains.

title: AWS IAM Read-Only Access Key pushed to public branch
description: Automated Trufflehog scanning detected AWS access key ID AKIA... in commit history.
immediateActions: Key disabled by AWS automated policy within 90 seconds. CloudTrail logs reviewed with zero unauthorized actions found.
